faq.q: How do I install Asphalt Legends on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Asphalt Legends and check the developer is Gameloft SE before tapping Install. It needs Android 9 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically, so you never need to download an APK by hand. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Gameloft SE and may be altered, so the safest way to play Asphalt Legends is the official listing.

faq.q: Is Asphalt Legends the same as Asphalt 9?
faq.a: Yes. Asphalt Legends is the current name of the game that launched as Asphalt 9: Legends and was later called Asphalt Legends Unite. It keeps the same Google Play package, so updates install over earlier versions and your progress carries over.

Yes, Asphalt Legends is free to download and play. Gameloft earns money from ads and optional in-app purchases, which Google Play lists from $0.29 to $199.99 per item, such as tokens, car packs and passes. Some purchases include random items.

faq.q: What Android version does Asphalt Legends need?
faq.a: Asphalt Legends 53.5.3a needs Android 9 or newer, according to its Google Play listing. It's a demanding game with detailed graphics, so it plays best on recent phones, and it needs plenty of free storage for its game data. Lower graphics settings help on older devices.

faq.q: Can I play Asphalt Legends offline?
faq.a: Asphalt Legends is designed to be played online. Multiplayer races, events and progress saving need an internet connection, and the game checks in with Gameloft's servers. A stable connection also avoids lag in online races. Playing on Wi-Fi also saves mobile data.
